       B2: Battle of the Atlantic                                                                                             British player
      Spring 1941. Britain is alone and wages a far-flung war stretching her naval assets thin. The Kriegsmarine now has
      access to Norwegian and French ports, from which it will soon be able to sortie surface raiders targeting vulnerable
      convoys. The Battle of the Atlantic is approaching a critical phase.

      “The Admiralty, with whom I lived in the closest amity and contact, shared these fears, all the more because it was their prime responsi-
      bility to guard our shores from invasion and to keep the life-lines open to the outer world. This had always been accepted by the Navy as
      their ultimate, sacred, inescapable duty. So we poised and pondered together on this problem. It did not take the form of flaring battles
      and glittering achievements. It manifested itself through statistics, diagrams, and curves unknown to the nation, incomprehensible to
      the public.”
                                                                                                          - Winston Churchill, Their Finest Hour
      Objective
      Your primary objective is to bring Convoys into port, unscathed. If the opportunity presents itself, sink enemy ships.
